interpretation: rho(Pe_architecture, max_chain_length) = 0.9724 (p=2.12e-15). Supercritical conditions (Pe >= 1) produce 2.9x longer chains. The prohibition-ritual pair (mineral + cycling) is necessary for Pe > 1. Neither alone is sufficient. Together they cross the Pe=1 threshold and produce order-of-magnitude improvement in polymerization outcomes. This is the same threshold dynamics as R0=1 in epidemiology (K-1) and Lotka-Volterra criticality (K-4) — same physics, different substrate.
